entries.title: Against the Storm
entries.definitive_edition: Against the Storm on Windows PC with Keepers of the Stone and Nightwatchers DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Keepers of the Stone and Nightwatchers DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full release, has the earliest DLC/update path, and is the best mouse/keyboard and capture route. Console versions are valid but do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Against the Storm on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store for Windows PC, then add Keepers of the Stone and Nightwatchers for the current complete content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console versions are later ports/access routes, not remasters or separate definitive editions.
